description: This PHP class defines the MakeUniqueEntityField process plugin for Drupal migrations, ensuring entity field values are unique during migration. It manages entity type, field, and migration-specific configurations, and interacts with Drupal's entity storage and migration ID map.

classes.name: MakeUniqueEntityField
classes.description: A Drupal migration process plugin class that ensures entity field values are unique during migration, with configurable options for entity type, field, migration status, and postfix.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the plugin with configuration, migration, and entity type manager.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the plugin with dependency injection.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a given value already exists in the specified entity field, considering migration status if configured.
